top_creatures.label: Ring-gated colossus
top_creatures.why: Hits from outside a 300-unit ring do nothing (line 48); resist depends on damage type (line 21)
top_creatures.keep: the ring rule and the damage-type split
top_creatures.change: pillars that block the line of hit instead of a ring clamp; serpent-coil body; ash and rust palette

top_creatures.label: Shard-split brute
top_creatures.why: Splits at half health; each split costs two levels and five size points with floors (min split level 45, min size 20)
top_creatures.keep: the half-health fork and the shrinking copy
top_creatures.change: the fork takes a different damage style; the parent does not refill to full (the code refills it, making each split a free heal)

top_creatures.label: Four-warden council
top_creatures.why: Four elemental adds spawn at fixed anchors, each bound to the boss, plus two healers
top_creatures.keep: one anchor per element and the healers
top_creatures.change: adds come in staggered rounds; each warden sets its own ground hazard

top_creatures.label: Fairy-warden reset
top_creatures.why: Fairy adds spawn on a 10 to 20 second timer while the boss is below full health; a reset heals the boss and clears the fairies
top_creatures.keep: adds that appear only while hurt, and a clean reset
top_creatures.change: adds spawn only in view; the reset is shown as a visible beat

top_creatures.label: Pale shiver aura
top_creatures.why: One visual pulse (effect 152) to every player in view on a jittered gap of 6 to 20 seconds
top_creatures.keep: the single broadcast and the jitter
top_creatures.change: a rising hum and a violet frost ring; the pulse tied to the creature's stance

top_creatures.label: Dusk and tide rosters
top_creatures.why: A day roster and a night roster share one brain and show or hide on the region's night flag
top_creatures.keep: one brain, two rosters, one zone clock
top_creatures.change: the clock is tide or weather; the rosters have different silhouettes

top_creatures.label: Stationary type-dial machine
top_creatures.why: Never walks (StartAttack override); physical resist 40, other types 70; absorb cap 85 percent in a comment
top_creatures.keep: a stationary boss with a split resist table
top_creatures.change: a readable damage-type dial in the HUD and visible vents instead of a plain bar

top_creatures.label: Ambient idle creature
top_creatures.why: Ambient-effect brain with one fixed effect id (5206); a plain creature with a constant idle effect
top_creatures.keep: a constant idle effect as the creature's identity
top_creatures.change: our own looping haze with a colour and rhythm

looks.label: Pulse aura broadcast
looks.technique: one effect (id 152) to every player in view on a jittered timer, so the pulse reads as a heartbeat

looks.label: Ambient idle effect
looks.technique: constant idle effect with fixed id 5206 marks a creature with no action

looks.label: Repeating pulse spell
looks.technique: next tick set from a pulse frequency; one active pulse per spell type, cleared when the owner stops it

looks.label: Shade model swap
looks.technique: player model replaced by a shade model as a state (not a new actor)

looks.label: Timed area burst
looks.technique: delayed area burst scheduled by timers; the visible tell is not in the code read

looks.label: Per-style animation id
looks.technique: each style returns an animation id, a per-style hook

looks.label: Material tag per armour
looks.technique: material enum as the hook for a shader or texture choice

originals.name: Ring-reach colossus
originals.idea: a boss that claims space with pillars that block the line of hit
originals.keep: the ring rule and the damage-type split
originals.change: ring clamp replaced by pillars; serpent-coil body; ash and rust palette

originals.name: Shard-split brute
originals.idea: a brute that splits at half health into smaller copies with a damage-style difference
originals.keep: half-health fork; shrinking copy with floors
originals.change: partial or no refill on split; the fork's damage style differs

originals.name: Four-warden council
originals.idea: four bound wardens on fixed anchors, plus healers, in staggered rounds
originals.change: staggered rounds; a ground hazard per warden

originals.name: Fairy-warden reset
originals.idea: adds that appear only while the boss is hurt, cleared on a reset
originals.keep: adds only while hurt; clean reset
originals.change: adds spawn only in view; reset as a visible beat

originals.name: Pale shiver aura
originals.idea: a single visual pulse to all nearby on a jittered gap
originals.change: rising hum and violet frost ring; pulse tied to stance

originals.name: Dusk and tide rosters
originals.idea: one brain with two rosters swapped by a world clock
originals.keep: one brain; two rosters; one clock
originals.change: tide or weather clock; rosters with different silhouettes

originals.name: Stationary type-dial machine
originals.idea: a boss that never moves and resists by damage type
originals.change: readable dial in the HUD; visible vents

originals.name: Positional chain strike

originals.change: window angles per weapon family; chain timing; guard the growth-rate divisor first
